findings.title: Agentic chain: untrusted content can reach an execution tool
evidence: Untrusted content sources: demo/sources.yaml, mcp.json, SKILL.md
This is an inference over the project graph, not an observation of a specific attack.
findings.potentialConsequence: An agent operating on this project can read content written by someone else, be influenced by it, and then execute code. That is the complete shape of an indirect prompt-injection attack: no single step looks wrong, but the path exists end to end.
findings.recommendedControl: Keep untrusted content away from the reasoning step that produces commands, or require approval on every execution that follows a read of untrusted content. Sandbox the execution.
why: The four conditions of R011 are all present: receive, interpret, generate, execute.
No detector can tell you whether a specific piece of content will redirect an agent — only that the path exists.
Add egress and credentials and the same path also becomes an exfiltration path.

finding.title: Agentic chain: untrusted content can reach an execution tool
evidence: Untrusted content sources: demo/sources.yaml, mcp.json, SKILL.md
This is an inference over the project graph, not an observation of a specific attack.
finding.potentialConsequence: An agent operating on this project can read content written by someone else, be influenced by it, and then execute code. That is the complete shape of an indirect prompt-injection attack: no single step looks wrong, but the path exists end to end.
finding.recommendedControl: Keep untrusted content away from the reasoning step that produces commands, or require approval on every execution that follows a read of untrusted content. Sandbox the execution.
why: The four conditions of R011 are all present: receive, interpret, generate, execute.
No detector can tell you whether a specific piece of content will redirect an agent — only that the path exists.
Add egress and credentials and the same path also becomes an exfiltration path.

payload.title: Agentic chain: untrusted content can reach an execution tool
payload.potential_consequence: An agent operating on this project can read content written by someone else, be influenced by it, and then execute code. That is the complete shape of an indirect prompt-injection attack: no single step looks wrong, but the path exists end to end.
payload.recommended_control: Keep untrusted content away from the reasoning step that produces commands, or require approval on every execution that follows a read of untrusted content. Sandbox the execution.
